meta.title: Bethelhem & Ermias — A Sacred Union
meta.description: Join Bethelhem and Ermias as they are joined in Christ. Wedding celebration invitation with schedule, location, and RSVP.

hero.verse: “Therefore what God has joined together, let no one separate.” — Mark 10:9

welcome.body: Join us for an evening of love, praise, and unforgettable memories as we begin our forever, bound together in the grace of Christ.
welcome.verseText: Love is patient, love is kind. It does not envy, it does not boast, it is not proud. It always protects, always trusts, always hopes, always perseveres.

telegram.title: Send Us Your Photos!
telegram.request: We would love to see our wedding through your eyes! Please send us your pictures and videos from the celebration through our dedicated Telegram bot.

footer.verse: “And over all these virtues put on love, which binds them all together in perfect unity.” — Colossians 3:14
